label: heart-s8
summary: The model is a linear logistic score on the direct edges with two nonlinear corrections, and the explanation covers it fully (full structural and compositional coverage, function preserved to 2.8e-16). The linear score carries most of the ranking (training AUC 0.947, 0.716 without it); its largest direct edges are the number of vessels coloured by fluoroscopy (2.09 per sd), male sex (1.42) and asymptomatic chest pain (1.21). An exercise-test ischaemia part acts as a hinge: it holds a floor for 155 of the 242 training patients and adds 2.73 to the score on average for the other 87, driven by exercise angina, ST depression, resting blood pressure and a non-upsloping ST segment, and blocked by typical angina; without it training AUC is 0.926. An age dampener lowers the score for asymptomatic patients and, for patients without exercise angina, increasingly with age, so for the typical asymptomatic man without exercise angina predicted risk falls from 16% at 55 years to 7% at 75 years, holding other inputs fixed; it matters little for ranking (AUC 0.9446 without it). Resting ECG is unconnected.
